experiments.scope: The disclosed deterministic straight-line constructor for the certificate pair, executed by the organizer across 256 isolated trials.
experiments.hypothesis: The emitted constructor reproduces certificates/msg_a.bin and certificates/msg_b.bin byte-for-byte and the two messages collide under the organizer's trusted rounds=1 digest; its observations report the operation ledger (203 data-path ops over 151 instructions; 323 including 112 packing ops and 8 packed 256-bit stores) and register liveness (144 allocated, 34 peak live).
